title: Toffy's Better Directional Placecments
description: Inverts the direction of placed directional blocks while sneaking
body:
Inverts the direction of placed directional blocks while sneaking in order to ease the experience of building. Placing a sticky piston on a wall, for example, will now place the sticky side facing the wall if sneaking while placed.
![Image shows how blocks are placed depending on whether the player is crouching](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8290dd9a89a323b4d86b2d99fbd19c726efc632.png)
